models.name: ConversationVersion
models.description: Conversation version stamp used to reconcile client-known summaries.

models.name: SyncConversationSummariesRequest
models.description: Request for summary sync with the caller's known conversation versions.

models.name: SyncConversationSummariesResponse
models.description: Summary sync result listing conversations missing or newer than the caller's known versions.

fields.name: changedConversations
fields.description: Conversations whose version is missing or newer after summary sync.

models.name: ConversationHistoryBackfillRequest
models.description: Request to backfill one conversation's historical messages into the local store.

fields.name: maxPages
fields.description: Maximum historical pages to request for this call.

models.name: ConversationHistoryBackfillResponse
models.description: Result of direct local-store historical backfill for one conversation.

fields.name: pagesLoaded
fields.description: Number of older pages that advanced the local oldest seq.

fields.name: oldestSeqBefore
fields.description: Oldest local conversation seq before backfill.

fields.name: oldestSeqAfter
fields.description: Oldest local conversation seq after backfill.

fields.name: hasMore
fields.description: Whether the server reported more history remains.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: True when this call reached the earliest visible history or the server reported no more pages.
